About this page: Live aircraft positions over Guangdong are fetched from the public OpenSky Network API every 30 seconds and drawn on an OpenStreetMap base. Directly embedding Flightradar24 is not allowed by the site, so the "Open Live Radar" button jumps to the exact Flightradar24 view (22.71, 112.92, zoom 8) in a new tab. Click any plane marker for its callsign, altitude, speed and heading. Data is informational only.
